name: Spotify Top Songs
author: datua
description: Serves Navidrome's artist top songs from Spotify (or Last.fm / Deezer) instead of ListenBrainz

http.reason: Fetch artist top tracks from Spotify, Last.fm, Deezer and MusicBrainz

sources.title: Source order
sources.description: Comma separated: spotify, lastfm, deezer. First one with results wins. spotify/deezer need no key, spotify is capped at 10 tracks.
